mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_DATE,'YYYY') AS yearDate FROM RD_PROJECT_ATTENDANCE_CONFIG
select TO_CHAR(CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') attendanceDate, ATTENDANCE_STATUS from RD_PROJECT_ATTENDANCE_CONFIG WHERE to_char(CALENDAR_DATE,'yyyy') = #{yearOfCalendar} ORDER BY CALENDAR_DATE

SELECT cra.BADGE , cra.EMPNAME username, D.DEPID , g.MONTH_OF_YEAR, D.LOCATION CHARGENAME, G.EID_CODE, SUM(G.ATTENDANCE_TIME) AS sum_Month FROM COMM_RD_ATTENDANCE cra LEFT JOIN COMM_RD_DEPARTMENT D ON cra.DEPID = D.DEPID LEFT JOIN RD_PROJECT_CONFIG G ON G.EID_CODE = cra.EID_CODE WHERE TO_CHAR(cra.CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM')= #{attendanceDate} AND TO_CHAR(g.CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') = #{attendanceDate} GROUP BY CRA.BADGE, CRA.EMPNAME, D.DEPID, G.MONTH_OF_YEAR, D.LOCATION, G.EID_CODE ORDER BY CRA.BADGE
